req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-005 requires HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number. The fixture contains squad numbers 1-26. Tests must cover: (1) a clearly non-existent squad number (EP/NEG), (2) boundary at squad number 0 (BVA - below minimum seeded value), (3) boundary at squad number 27 (BVA - one above maximum seeded value), (4) boundary at squad number 26 (BVA - last seeded value returns 200, not 404), and (5) a large/arbitrary unknown number (NEG - negative kind must use NEG heuristic). The violation was test[6]: kind=negative but heuristic=EP. Fixed by changing heuristic to NEG for that test. Each test asserts the exact status code 404 to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: Squad number 10 (Lionel Messi) exists in the database
expected: Response body contains squadNumber 10 and lastName Messi
trace: R-PLAYER-005: confirms the 404 branch is NOT triggered for a known squad number
Catches mutations that always return 404 regardless of lookup result
Catches boolean-negation mutation on `if not player`
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_known_squad_number_returns_200_not_404():
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Messi'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Lionel'
